paragraphs: PCS Revenue Control Systems sells school food and nutrition technology to the K-12 market, offering products and services across that one segment. The product offering covers prepayments on the web, free and reduced application processing, meal accountability, claims reporting, menu nutrition analysis, food purchases and inventory control. Services sold alongside the software include project management, training, webinars, continuing maintenance, upgrades, and support.

The stated market is the K-12 Nutrition community, served by a team of food service professionals, dietitians, engineers and computer scientists building cloud based business solutions. Software, hardware and services are offered for every type of user and task, and the pages say many customers have been with the company over twenty five years. Compliance with state and federal regulations is named as part of how the products and services are improved.

Products and services can be bought through buying co-ops, with the pages naming BuyBoard, PEPPM, and TIPS. Testimonials on the site are attributed to staff at Pampa ISD in Texas and at Ottumwa Community Schools in Iowa.

quote.text: We are 100% focused on student nutrition solutions.
